title: Understanding the Sampling Frame
text: The sampling frame is the list or group from which the sample is drawn. Consider who is being asked to participate in the survey.

title: Focus on the Discussion Sections
text: Think about the specific group of students that are being targeted in the discussion sections. Who are they?

hintAnswer: All Data $$100$$ students that attend discussion section this week.
title: Identify the Group
text: Who are the students that attend the Data $$100$$ discussion sections this week?
choices: All Data $$100$$ students that attend discussion section this week.
All UC Berkeley students that spend an $$above-average$$ amount on chocolate milk.
Every fifth student in the discussion section.

title: Clarifying the Sampling Frame
text: The sampling frame includes all individuals who could potentially be selected for the survey. In this case, who are they?
choices: All Data $$100$$ students that attend discussion section this week.
All UC Berkeley students that spend an $$above-average$$ amount on chocolate milk.
Every fifth student in the discussion section.
